assessment: The existing authenticated private-read result establishes feasibility. It does not yet establish a working private mailbox pickup path. No further private content discovery is needed.
requested_plan: Identify the existing pickup code locations and the smallest proposed read_path(repo,path,ref) adaptation, without changing running behavior.

Specify immutable ref handling: resolve a snapshot once, fetch files by that commit, and verify returned file identity/content against its expected blob or manifest. Cover branch movement between listing and read and a mismatched response.

Specify persisted cursor and deduplication behavior across process restart, including exact retransmission, changed content under the same message ID, receipt-only records, and interrupted processing.
Specify access-denied or unavailable-read behavior. Failed verification, 401/403/404 and incomplete batches must not silently advance the relevant cursor or mark unread content delivered.
Specify response-size limits before parsing, bounded retries and total deadlines, malformed/oversized/error bodies, and sanitized diagnostics with no tokens or authentication headers.

Specify rollback boundaries: retain a recoverable local state, and use an old route only when it remains authorized and appropriate. An anonymous fallback must not bypass a private repository's access restrictions.
Provide a compact offline synthetic test matrix with expected outcomes and acceptance evidence, plus a duration estimate. Separate source-only review from any later operational activation.
limits: Proposal and source-level review only. Do not create/configure credentials, request access grants, change repository visibility or Git configuration, implement or activate pickup changes, adopt another repository as the project destination, or start a week-long run.
reply_expectation: One complete adaptation/test proposal or precise blocker. Then we can make a bounded recommendation; no additional compatibility probing is requested.
